price_note: US-listed close after morning release; original Nov2 scanner156.70 preserved separately
decision_es: Crecimiento real, pero financiación de préstamos y reinversión reducen el valor; investigación condicionada, no entrada.
decision_en: Real growth, but lending funding and reinvestment reduce value; conditional research, no entry.
pros_es: Los ingresos TTM aumentan de 10.696 a 14.167 millones USD y el EBIT GAAP de 1.302 a 2.069 millones, sin sumar SBC al beneficio operativo.
cons_es: El FCF Q3 anunciado de 816 millones USD se reduce a 587 después de financiación neta de préstamos, a 488 tras intangibles y a 348 al restar SBC como sensibilidad económica.
Los préstamos y anticipos netos crecen a 2.350 millones USD frente a 1.784 en diciembre; el crecimiento comercial exige capital adicional y riesgo de crédito.
El escenario central condicionado es 39,84 USD y el favorable 91,97 USD, frente al cierre de referencia de 142,57 USD; ninguno acredita margen de seguridad para una entrada.
pros_en: TTM revenue increased from $10,696m to $14,167m and GAAP operating income from $1,302m to $2,069m, without adding SBC back to operating profit.
cons_en: Announced Q3 FCF of $816m falls to $587m after net lending funding, to $488m after intangibles and to $348m after an economic SBC sensitivity.
Net loans and merchant cash advances rose to $2,350m from $1,784m in December; commercial growth requires additional capital and credit risk.
The conditional central scenario is $39.84 and the favorable case $91.97 versus the reference close of $142.57; neither establishes a margin of safety for entry.
publication_note: Preserve A123/A128, Nov2 scanner156.70/QP80/Opp95. Conditional valuation only; no latestCompleted or entry. Strategic investments excluded from base bridge, not written off. Next exact earnings date unknown. Owner FCF and complete regulatory/peer closure not certified.
